name: First Steps
description: Begin your adventure.
location: Speak to the Wise Old Man in the Temple, in Temple Woods.

steps.text: Go and speak to the Wise Old Man in the temple. He will tell you about the dragon and offer to teach you about the basics, which you can either accept or refuse. If you refuse it, you can talk with him again in Bramblemead Village to finish the quest. If you accept the tutorial, he will send you to Doric just outside the temple, starting Getting Started.
This step is covered, in more detail, through the following quest articles: Getting Started, Ratcatcher, and Rune Mysteries.

Doric will teach you how to make processing stations, introduce to you the building system, and then send you off to Vannaka. The slayer master will send you to fight off nearby rats, teach you how to cook your food, and help you know which way the pointy end goes before sending you to Zanik. When you talk to Zanik, she will help you learn the magic system, crafting runes for spells, and even unlock a spell or two. When she has taught you everything, she'll then send you off to the Wise Old Man.

After completing the above section, or if you skipped the tutorial, go to Bramblemead Village and find the Wise Old Man on the first floor of a ruined building at the far end of the village. Talk to him to learn about the next step in your adventure.

name: Getting Started
description: Doric wants to teach you some survival basics.
location: Speak to Doric outside of the Temple.

steps.text: To start the quest, the player must accept to learn the basics in the First Steps quest.
steps.section: Doric wants to teach you some survival basics

steps.text: After you accept it, go and talk to Doric just outside the temple. He will teach you about the importance of sustenance (food) and hydration (drink). He will send you to get some water (and maybe some redberries on the way). Go south or north to the pond, go into the water, and get at least one dirty water (default hotkey: E). Go back to Doric, who will tell you that you need to boil the water, otherwise it will have side effects (you will be poisoned, it is implied, by Soulscourge if you drink too much dirty water). Then he will tell you that you need to craft a stone club.
steps.section: Doric wants to teach you some survival basics

steps.text: Gather at least one ash log or stone to open the building menu, from where you can build the crafting table. You need to gather 4 ash logs to make the crafting table, and an additional 6 ash logs and 8 stone to craft the stone club. The logs can be found lying around the trees, and stones can be found lying around the ruins of the temple. Speak to Doric when you have the club. He will send you to Vannaka to learn to fight, starting Ratcatcher.
steps.section: Doric wants to teach you some survival basics

name: Ratcatcher
description: Vannaka wants to teach you the basics of hunting, fighting and cooking.
location: Speak to Vannaka south of the Windmill.

steps.text: Talk to Vannaka.
Head to the windmill in the north of Temple Woods.
Kill four giant rats and get four raw rat meats.
Cook two rat roasts. You will need to make a campfire using 4 ash logs and 4 stones. You will also need ash logs to fuel the fire
Return to Vannaka with the cooked rat roasts.

name: Rune Mysteries
description: Zanik wants you to learn the basics of crafting runes.
location: Speak to Zanik east of Vannaka.

steps.text: Talk to Zanik

Obtain 50 ash logs. You can obtain ash logs by picking up spawns from the ground or uprooting Ash Saplings. You can also create a stone logging axe using 6 stone and 8 ash logs at the crafting table and use this to cut ash trees.
Return to Zanik
Mine rune essence using the stone pickaxe which Zanik gives you. Rune essence can be mined from the lumps of essence on the ground next to rune essence geysers.
Build a rune altar. This requires 12 stone and 4 rune essence.
Craft some air runes and astral runes.
Return to Zanik.

name: Dragon Slayer
description: Recruited with promises of glory, your first challenge is to defeat General Velgar.
location: Speak to the Wise Old Man in Bramblemead Village.

steps.text: To start this quest, speak to the Wise Old Man in Bramblemead Village and he will instruct you on getting started with hunting down General Velgar. Before you can start hunting dragons, you need a shelter. He will tell you to build a little shelter, with at least a bed roll in it, which you have to claim. To be able to claim it, you need to build at least a foundation, 3 walls, and a ceiling, and place the bed roll in it. Once you finish your task, talk with him again.

He will tell you that one of the adventurers, young Cathan is missing and needs to be found. To do this, he will cast a locator spell, but he needs some antlers for that. Hunt down deers in the valley and bring the antlers to him. As they tend to run away, you need a ranged or magic weapon to kill them.
The spell will point you to a nearby castle within the valley, so this will be your next destination.

When you arrive at the Keep of Blue Flames, it will look eerily similar to Lumbridge Castle, but with Bandosian banners flying. This place will have a lot of goblins, so pack some food. You will find Cathan's Journal lying at the top of the castle next to a loot chest. Read his journal and you will learn that you need to go to the Whispering Swamp to locate a "blue-flame door". At this point, Velgar will descend to the keep, spraying poison next to the gate, then attack with his poison puddles. You can either wait for his attack to end or just run out of the keep, dodging the strikes.

Journey through the "blue-flame door" (the dragonkin vault Vertentis Kara) and speak to Spitfoot at the end of the vault. He will detail Cathan's journey, his betrayal, and his desire to go to Ghornfell. Take this information back to the Wise Old Man in the Bramblemead Valley, and he will remark about Cathan's foolish recklessness. After telling you that if he is willing to brave the Garou, Cathan must have a way to deal with Velgar, he will ask you to dive into Ghornfell to pick up his trail.

Once you arrive in the Fractured Plains (an area of Ghornfell), you will then be prompted to go check out Velgar's Rise, a monumental tower at the heart of the region, for any information on Cathan's whereabouts.

When you arrive at the Rise, you will encounter Cathan's ghost. Speak to him and he will talk about how he was so sure he could defeat Velgar (after remarking how death sucked). He will tell you that the Garou mobbed him and dragged him to the tower, holding him down in front of Velgar as they sacrificed him. He will then give you a recipe to make a challenge horn that can challenge Velgar in his tower.
steps.section: Part III: The Beginnings of a Legend...

steps.text: You need to travel to both Bloodblight Swamp and Stormtouched Highlands to gather the materials for the horn.
steps.section: Part III: The Beginnings of a Legend...

steps.text: In the Highlands you have to travel past the skeleton which the Garou use as home on the western part and you can find a dragon skull. You can mine it's teeth with an iron pickaxe to get the dragon tooth.
steps.section: Part III: The Beginnings of a Legend...

steps.text: In the swamp, you have to travel to the castle on the most southern point. In the castle you can find the bloodwood tree (and some Garou), and you can harvest it with iron logging axe to gather the bloodwood sap.
steps.section: Part III: The Beginnings of a Legend...

steps.text: Combine them with 5 bronze bar and you can create the horn.
steps.section: Part III: The Beginnings of a Legend...

steps.text: When you have the horn, grab your best armour and weapon, bring some antipoison potions and food, and enter Velgar's Rise. The top of the tower is basically a triangle, with a pedestal at the centre. When you place the horn on the dragonkin altar, Velgar will arrive on one corner.
steps.section: Part IV: Fight for your life

steps.text: He will use poison spray and poison puddle bombs or stomp both his legs, which will create spikes in your direction. If you get close to using melee, he will stomp one leg, which is closer to you, and also bite forward and hit sideways with his head. All of his attacks are delayed, so you can prepare and dodge, and between each attack he will wait a bit.
steps.section: Part IV: Fight for your life

steps.text: After he loses 1/4 of his health, he will fly away and use his poison puddle bomb attack multiple times. After that, he will land on another corner, the next of the previous one, clockwise. In the second phase, he will use multiple attacks one after another, before he waits a bit. The attacks are the same as in the previous phase.
steps.section: Part IV: Fight for your life

steps.text: After his health is brought to half, he will again fly away, and his signature attack will happen again. He will land again on another edge, still next to the previous one, clockwise, and the fight continues like before. He will once more fly away when he loses 3/4 of his health. He will land on the original edge, where he can be attacked again.
steps.section: Part IV: Fight for your life

steps.text: Once Velgar is defeated, you will get his head. Go outside of the tower, speak to the Wise Old Man (who has replaced Cathan's ghost), and give him the head to complete this quest.
steps.section: Part IV: Fight for your life

items.name: Dragon tooth
items.note: iron pickaxe needed to gather

items.name: Bloodwood sap
items.note: iron logging axe needed to gather

rewards: Tome of Construction - Vol 1. (After being asked to get antlers)
After following Cathan into Ghornfell - containing 3 clay, 3 redberries, and 3 harralander.
End of quest - containing a Tome of the Dragon Slayer, a noxious draconic visage, and an anti-dragon shield.

name: Withering Heights
description: Put an end to the horror of Fellhollow by defeating Imaru, the soul-devourer.
location: Speak to the Wise Old Man near Ashien's Watch.

steps.text: To begin this quest, speak with the Wise Old Man near Ashien's Watch. He will explain that he had been studying a mysterious door with some sort of strange necromantic runes on it, and tells you the password to get past the door.

Use option 1 after speaking to the Wise Old Man, to open the door, and you will arrive at the Forgotten Temple. As there is already a lodestone here, you will not need to spend your own materials to make a lodestone. Step up the steps and head into the temple to speak to Death, who will inform you about Imaru and the overall situation in Fellhollow. You will then follow out the right side (your right) towards a place where you can speak to Postie Pete about entering Fellhollow, but before you do, Death will say one more thing. This will, inevitably, introduce you to his store, where you can buy (using soul fragments) exclusive rare items that cannot be acquired through vestiges and normal gameplay. Note: There will be a small intro cutscene that plays when you first enter Fellhollow.

Next, speak to Postie Pete. He will then explain that, in order to get into Fellhollow, you must cross a river of wither water. As you cross through the water, you will build up Wither and feel your soul rift. Just before crossing fully, you will enter the soul rift state and be able to use the nearby spectral door. Enter this door, and you will arrive in one of the regions that make up Fellhollow: Bleakfields Valley. As soon as you arrive, you must quickly find a fountain (marked on your compass with visible blue beacons) to purify your soul, for Imaru will have sensed your arrival into her domain. The longer you are in this state, the more danger you are in, as the tormented souls (human, wolves, etc) will start to appear at growing power levels.
steps.section: Part II: Fraying the soul to rift...

steps.text: For this instance of arrival, quickly follow the path, and you will reach one such fountain. You will have to hit the spectral tangles until they disappear to be able to purify your soul.
steps.section: Part II: Fraying the soul to rift...

steps.text: Once you arrive in this place, seek out Cathan. He will be nearby on a cliff, floating next to three stone tablets with strange markings. Note: After arriving in Fellhollow for the first time (aka accessing the temple and soul-rifting through the spectral door), you will be granted permanent access to Fellhollow in all worlds.
steps.section: Part II: Fraying the soul to rift...

steps.text: Speak to Cathan to uncover what else to do next, which is to gather curse fragments. There are only three you need to collect: Curse fragment (grief); Curse fragment (rage); Curse fragment (despair)
Once you have acquired all three curse fragments, you will then be able to gain access to Imaru's Tower in the centre of Hope's Fall.

To get this fragment, you will need to interact with four pillars that are nearby to dispel a divine barrier. You will need to find the corresponding shrines (which can be activated in any order) to dispel it.

Once all of the altars are activated, the barrier will be dispelled, allowing you to enter Emberwood Village and obtain the curse fragment (grief). Note: If you start a fresh world, regardless of how far you have done the quest or fully completed it, you will need to re-activate all of the statues to dispel the barrier.

Guthix altar: Defeat a green dragon (can be safespotted with ranged attacks, must be at least 150m away to avoid the dragon attacking) and interact with it. It will be within a druid circle to the west. Note: The Guthix altar will not allow interaction until the green dragon has been defeated.

Saradomin altar: A bit north-east, you will find it atop a lone rock within a small lake. You will need to repair this altar first by finding the Saradomin symbol down below (in the water) and interact with it again.

Armadyl altar: A bit east of where you defeated the green dragon, on a small island in the river, there are three ghosts who have committed a grave injustice. You must find the perpetrator and solve the crime in order to activate this altar. Choose the following options: 3 - There was a mass murder. 2 - Because they thought it was funny. 3 - The snickering ghost. 3 - They found it too funny. Matching the motive. (The option about the weather also works)

Zamorak altar: You will need to enter a nearby temple through the roof and jump into the temple to interact with the altar. There is a lever nearby to open the gate to the temple so you can leave freely.

To obtain this fragment, you must venture into the Vekchenven Kara vault that is underneath a waterfall. You will need to defeat a zogre at the end of the dungeon in order to access this shard. Once you defeat the zogre, you will then be free to obtain the curse fragment (rage).
steps.section: Curse fragment (rage) - Lake of Lost Souls

steps.text: To obtain this fragment, you will need to venture into the keep itself. There will be many rotsworn zombies, skeletal archers, rotsworn warriors, rotsworn marauders, and zombies in the way as you head up towards the fragment, but there will be a green dragon in front of it. Interact with the curse seal, and you will obtain the curse fragment (despair).
Item(s) required: curse fragment (rage), curse fragment (grief), curse fragment (despair).
Item(s) recommended: food, power level 5 gear, and potions.

Go into the tower within Hope's Fall and interact with the seal on Imaru's lair. You will then be prompted to enter her lair by dispelling the curse, and by choosing option 1, you will be able to enter her lair. Upon entering her lair, there will be four purifying pools, spots of wither rot, and an atmosphere of death and decay. Imaru will come out of the nearby river in front of you, and you'll be able to fight her. Be warned, as this boss will phase in and out of the soul rift state and attempt to heal herself by devouring souls.

Once she is defeated, you will gain Imaru's head. Make sure to have one free inventory space to complete the quest. Now you will head back to Death, who will exclaim that Imaru is dead and that you've done well to deal with a potential problem that he didn't want to deal with. Hand him Imaru's head and you will complete the quest.

rewards: Access to a new type of masterwork recipe: the dragoncurse shield.

name: Black Knight's Fortress
description: Uncover the secrets of Dowdun Reach in order to unlock your way through to the Umbral Sands.
location: Speak to Death in the Forgotten Temple.

steps.text: Speak to Death in the Forgotten Temple. He will mention about how you did well in Fellhollow, but that there is more for you to do. A colleague of his is waiting for you in the Umbral Sands to help him, but instructs you to speak to Cathan to gather allies and investigate. You can find Cathan east of Fellhollow, near the ominous gatehouse in the south of Silverthorn Keep.

Speak to Cathan, who greets you, and he will comment about how the adventure never ends. He will then right to it and explain how he has been investigating the ominous gatehouse and, while it leads to some fortress, it is blocking the way to the Umbral Sands. He tells you how he wanted to scout out the place more all spooky-like, but made the mistake of mentioning it to the Wise Old Man. Knowing how he is like, Cathan mentioned about how he murmured some stuff like "amateur hour wards" and "rubbish defences" before storming down the passageway. Cathan will inform you that, if you want to go after him, to look for him in some sort of central point (like a nexus or something). Go through the open gateway and enter through the ominous door (Image right). Note: This will play a small intro cutscene to the area.
You will then arrive within The Approach. Traverse southward through this new region until you enter The Courtyard where you will meet the Wise Old Man.

Speak to the Wise Old Man, who will mention about how you had an easier time getting here than they did and walloping a few troublesome people. He'd then mention about how he was hoping to hunt down another dragon to whittle down Kuldra's forces, but complains about the fortress full of Zamorakians in the way. Despite the bothersome trouble in the way, he mentions how great it is that you're here to help get them moving again. Troubling thing is, he mentions how the way is blocked by someone called "the gatekeeper" and he isn't sure who or what it may be. Despite not being aware of who or what it is, the Wise Old Man tells you that Doric is currently working on dispelling a nasty magical barrier further ahead in the Nexus. He then says how it might be a good idea to make a base camp here first.

After making a base camp, follow the path leading up into the fortress. Arrive at The Nexus and speak to Doric. Once you speak to him, he will mention about how crazed the Black Knights are along with how they look like they should have all died long ago. He mentions how the problem is that you are all stuck here and he has everything to get the door open. As far as Doric can tell, everything seems to be connected to a great big stone next to him. He says that it looks broken and, theorising a way to get past the door, might need to fix it using some missing pieces. Inspect the stone.

This will reveal a small dialogue from the stone itself describing how it is broken, shards of itself are missing, and that you should find the missing pieces to repair it. It will then give you authorisation to look around the keep and to access the Nexus nodes scattered around Dowdun Reach.
Item(s) needed: Spade, Pickaxe, Logging Axe.

After inspecting the Dreaming Stone, you will discover that there are thirteen shards (marked on your map with yellow circles) that are needed to repair it. These shards are scattered throughout Dowdun Reach and require you to either interact with characters, scenery objects, or solve puzzles to acquire them. While most are above-ground, there are three that are kept underground. Once you have collected all thirteen shards, head back to the Dreaming Stone.

South-West: Cut down vines w/ mithril logging axe then standard interact. You can acquire the cathedral shard by heading south-west to a courtyard full of Zamorakian acolytes and mages and, using your mithril (or above) logging axe, cut down the vines. As the mages and acolytes are hostile by default, you will need to take them down first.

East: Defeat Sergeant Blister. He is located underground in The Garrison region, protected by two hellhounds and a small host of skeletons. The requirements to interact/collect this shard are the same as defeating the shardbound lesser demons.

West: Standard interact. Navigate past the elite Black Knight and two Zamorakian acolytes to an open wall with some wooden boards. Use the Windstep spell to jump up and across to the nearby adjacent tower. Once you have arrived, either defeat or avoid the elite Black Knight to interact with the shard.
East: Interact with Spittletoe. Spittletoe instructs you to collect five Maple Sap. Once you provide the sap, Spittletoe will trade you the shard.

Speak with Spittletoe Speak with Spittletoe, while having the maple sap in your inventory. Continue dialogue until you receive a shard. Note: When interacting with Spittletoe in the kitchen, it is possible for the Zogre to aggro the player from above, even without being in line of sight. If you do not have the maple sap, look for maple trees and chop them down till you get one

North-West: Defeat 2x shardbound lesser demon. Open the library door by interacting with (in order) the following books: The Empty Throne; The Eye of Oculus; Taking the Crown; Zamorak's Rebellion. Note: You can make it easier to take them down by leading them into the spiral staircase. Despite the player needing to interact with the doorway to phase through, the lesser demons can walk through the doorway as if it is not there.

South-West: Interact with Valerius. Go to the top of the staircase (a floor above where Valerius can be found) and West, past the blue dragon, and veer right as soon as you pass under the cliff. Equip your spade and dig in front of the gargoyle statue to uncover the glass owl. Return this item to Valerius to acquire this shard.

South: Dig with spade. Cut down vines w/ mithril logging axe. Find three levers to unlock the door. The first lever is inside of the broken down roof of the tiny house (located next to the windmill). You'll need to cast Windstep to reach the roof, then use your spade here to dig it up and interact with it. The second lever is inside of a cave nearby protected by a thorny vine wall along the rock wall to the right of the shard. You will need a mithril or better logging axe to chop these vines. The third and final lever is on the top level of the nearby stone ruins, located beside the air anima vent. You'll need to use Windstep to reach this level. This area is guarded by a lesser blue dragon.

South-East: Standard interact. Follow along the lower area cliffs to reach an area where you can jump across. You'll also locate a group of hellhounds on your way there, but you can either ignore them or defeat them until you locate a series of beams. Traverse the beams by jumping up to the next level until you reach the top where you'll need to jump across to the stone rock where the shard is located. Note: You'll need plenty of air runes to use Windstep for this particular jumping puzzle. An alternative way is to equip your leggings of lightness and use Windstep from where you received the previous shard from finding the three levers, down to the cliffs. Be sure not to jump and head down, instead, fall with the spell and the leggings to avoid damage.

North: Mine a granite deposit. Reach the highest part of the goblin-infested fortress. In the middle of the area, there is a granite deposit that hides the shard. You can either avoid or defeat the blue dragon here to get to the shard, but you can use the Rocksplosion spell to quickly interact with the shard.
East: Interact button. Defeat the goblins in the immediate area of the shard before interacting with it.
These are located underground, they can be completed in any order.

The Crypt: Dig with spade/shovel. Navigate to The Crypt in the underground region. Before searching for the shard, defeat the zogre here. This will save you trouble later. Interact with the note next to the goblin corpse to learn that the shard is buried in a grave. Dig at any of the graves until you uncover the shard. Note: The location of this shard is randomized for every world.

The demon gate: Defeat 2x shardbound lesser demon. Navigate to the lowest part of the region. There is a lever-activated elevator that will take you down to the demon gate region. For easier traversal later, interact with the nearby nodestone to connect it to the Nexus. Navigate through the pathways until you reach the stone structure and defeat the two lesser demons guarding the shard.

The Lake: Speak with Offalfoot. He will ask you to give him one of the fish nearby (requires an empty inventory slot), so you'll need to grab one from the nearby pool of fish. This will give you an unusual trout and give this trout to Offalfoot. He'll give you the shard. Note: You do need a fishing rod (the highest level is recommended) and this can be done with level 1 Fishing. You will encounter Delrom when traversing to through this location.

Interact with the Dreaming Stone. It will say that it is restored, but it will reveal that it was evil! It will claim that its name will rattle in your tiny skull like the echoes within a cave. The Dreaming Stone then reveals its name to be Avisk the eternal whose mind had ever graced the Aughra, but as it tries to enslave you and become its thrall, it seemed stunned. This will reveal two dialogue options (both of which are about destroying the stone), but choose option one. This will force the crystal to acknowledge your logic and, in its own way, apologise for being overzealous and how it happens when you've been alone in the psyche of Black Knights for too long. It then blames the Cthonian before taking down the barrier.

It then warns you to be wary of Lord Rasmodel (aka the Black Knight Titan) as it had a bit of a mishap when he smashed the Dreaming Stone to pieces. Now, he's got some of the Dreaming Stone , some of a demon, and a whole lot of anger issues. End the dialogue and the Dreaming Stone will be fully repaired.

Interact with the newly-dropped Barrier and you'll arrive in The Bastion. Head up all the stairs (be mindful of some gaps which can be Windstepped) until you reach the top. Enter into the Bastion building and, just past a barrier, slay the boss. Interact with the barrier to fight the Titan. After defeating him, return to the Dreaming Stone. Note: The barrier may not allow you to teleport through if you have not unblocked all of the nodestones; with the exception of The Bastion.

Talk to the Dreaming Stone/Avsik. It will remark how impressive it was that you slew the Titan and that when he finds himself a new body to walk among the world again, he'd like for you to work with him. Aside from that, he remarks about how the gate to the Umbral Sands hasn't been opened in a long time, so he'll need time to get it unstuck. He also pleads for you to be patient - and to stay your hammer - as he will help get you into the desert soon. He then gives you a reward (read: bribe) for not smashing him to pieces with your hammer.
steps.section: Part V: To the Umbral Sands!

items.name: Fishing Rod
items.note: Any, preferably highest available

rewards: +750 XP to Magic, Ranged, and Attack
Recipe to creating the Titan's wrath 2h sword

name: Icthlarin's Little Helper
description: Slay the tyrant dragon Fuzan and unite the Moon Garou along the way
location: Enter the Umbral Sands using the Door to Umbral Sands.

steps.text: Note: Interacting with the door to the Umbral Sands will play a small introduction cutscene to the region.

After defeating the Black Knight Titan and talking to Avisk, head back to The Bastion and interact with the door to the Umbral Sands. It is highly recommended that you do this during the night cycle at full rest. Once you have interacted with the door, you will arrive at the Alcarrid Oasis sub-region. Speak to Shangruuh right as you arrive to start the quest.

Arriving to the camp, speak to Ancamairon, who will next to Icthlarin. Icthlarin requests one of the mirror lens they hold in order to use the mirrors and break the seal that blocks Fuzan's tower. The garou does not trust an outsider, let alone a demigod, with their sacred item. So you will be asked to gain the trust of the Moon Garou, starting with the Alcarrid camp.
Once you accept the quest, you'll need to speak to certain NPCs to progress.
Speak to any of them to start the tasks needed to convince the elder of the Alcarrid tribe.
Item(s) required: Mithril pickaxe (or better), inventory space.

Speak to Domri who will request that you locate three moonstones that are likely hidden in the western area of the desert under some gypsum nodes within rocky areas or caves. The map and compass will direct you to the locations. Be sure to check each nodes to find the moonstone. Once you visit all three locations, return to Domri, who will be shocked that the moonstones are real and will reward you with his trust and access to his shop. Note: By completing reputation quests, you can unlock more items to trade with him including unique vestiges.
Item(s) required: 3 adamant bar. If mining the materials: a mithril pickaxe (or better), 9 adamantite ore and 9 coal.

Speak to Valas, and they will remark about how your task to repair the mirrors smells like folly to them. They commend your spirit, but then tell you how the mirrors are sacred to them because of the River Goddess placing them there to remind them of who must protect Umbral Sands.

Speak to Valas again when you have the bars. Click on option 1 to hand over the bars, and they will say that they will fix the mirrors for you when you collect all of the lenses. They will inform the elder of your part in getting that job done and give you a nice farewell. They will also give you 200 garou chit for your troubles.
Item(s) required: 3 raw farm meat, 3 kalphite shell fragments, and 3 cactus steaks

Speak to Lagra, who wants you to help them with a task and clarifies that they are a butch (or butcher) and want you to bring them three of the following: Raw farm meat, kalphite shell fragments, and cactus steaks. You can collect the raw farm meat from nearby vultures, goats, or from your own chests if you have any. The shell fragments can also be found by killing kalphites in the desert or if you have some already. As for cactus steaks, you only need to chop down one or two bunny cactuses with an adamant (or better) logging axe or collect them from your chests.

Speak to Lagra again when you have the items. Choose option 1 to hand over the meats, and they will praise your work by saying that you have an eye for dead tissue and exoskeletons. They will give you their trust and give you 200 garou chit for your troubles.

Once you have completed the three tasks above, return to Ancamairon. He will mention that the Alcarrid clan now trusts you and that the butcher has even made a dish after you. Reward: Moon Garou pack and a new Magic Carpet mount.

After completing the tasks for the Alcarrid clan, you now have to navigate to other areas of the desert to collect their lenses. You can go to either the Manafem clan in the southern area of the desert (within the Manafem Plains) or the Uzzer clan in the east (within the Dunes of Uzzer) and speak to their respective elders to discuss building reputation and claiming the lenses.

Speak to Dúshlánach in the Manafem camp. They will mention that you are a bad omen at a bad time, calling you Unmarked, and reveal they bear the Mark of Fuzan and how that mark is a wound that carves deep. From this Mark, they are slowly losing their will to fight and their sanity, but they do say that their pride is not being lost. They say that while the clan needs help, they are reluctant to accept it. This means that their tasks will be somewhat harder. Just like with the Alcarrid clan, there are three tasks that must be done to acquire their lens. Note: Beartach will not offer any quests, but completing the reputation quests will increase his reputation by one level.
Item(s) required: Good weapons, armour, food and 5 air runes

Speak to Laguna, who is sitting next to a net fishing spot. They would like you to venture into the Vault located south of the camp and write down the lyrics of the songs as they do not like beetles and heard that beetles reside within the vault.

The vault they spoke of will be circled in green on your map. Be warned that this is a kalphite nesting area, so you will need to rush to the entrance to avoid being outnumbered by kalphites and KotHaar that lurk around the area.

Enter the vault door and head towards the next platform. You will need to summon a scarab staff and take it with you, as this will prevent the scarabs within the dungeon from hurting you. After summoning the staff, the first ancient garou statue will be to the right. Collect this before continuing deeper into the vault.

You will be in combat sometime, and the staff can be swapped for you to protect yourself, which will allow you to pick the staff back up. In the first room, follow the path that leads to a lever, pull it but to not proceed as east of the lever there is a ancient garou statue for you to transcribe. Follow the path and head into the next room, where the statue will be located on top of a platform, requiring Windstep to reach. Now that you have acquired all of the lyrics, you may return to Laguna in the Manafem camp. Note: The next two levers will open the way to one of the Kalphite Queens. If you are prepared, you can enter the encounter to claim extra reward on beating her, such as the keris' vestige, corroded curved blade.
Speak to Laguna again and they will be happy that you found them all and wants to weave them into a song. After that, they promise to vouch for you with the Manafem Elder.

Item(s) required: Good weapons, armour, and food. Speak to Hedric, he'll tasks you with looking for his lost scouting party. The scouting party were tracking a creature that had been picking off his people one by one and asks you to look for them towards the east and kill the beast.

After talking with Hedric, head towards the green area on your map east from the Manafem camp. Within that area, there will be three clues in the area, two dead garou scouts and a scorched mark. You'll learn that the scouting party is dead, and Neither the Scorch, the sandstorms or Fuzan could have made them, but something else. Head further east to where the green circle is on your map and you will find a red dragon. Kill it and gain the radiant heart.

Head back to Hedric and speak with him and you will recount how you found their bodies and slain the red dragon nearby. He will thank you for finding their bodies and, that now you made it safe, will send someone to go collect their bodies. He will remark that the dragon you slain is small-fry compared to Fuzan, hopes you know what your doing, and recommended you to their Elder. He will give you 200 garou chit for your troubles.
Item(s) required: 1 clean water.

Speak to Manathep and she will tell you about how the Dearg Due killed her poor Efina. She mentions that Efina was taken three days ago and every night, the Dearg Due watches her from the south of their camp with a glint in her eye and blood on her lips. She asks you to kill the Dearg Due south of the camp and bring back Efina's body.

Head west of the pyramid vault and track down the Dearg Due in the sandstorm. Follow it until you meet Efina. Speak to her and she will ask for clean water. Give her some clean water and she will say that her strength is coming back to her while thanking you. she then reveals that she ran away from the Manafem camp due to the Mark of Fuzan draining everyone. She then asks you to tell her mum that she is safe and on her way back. The Dearg Due howls back, but you get the sense that a curse has been lifted and the Dearg Due is free to move on from this world.

Return to speak to Manathep. She will praise the River Goddess in joy that her daughter is safe and thinks that the Dearg Due lured her out of the camp as a trick and says the Efina wouldn't go out there alone. She will then give you 200 garou chit for your troubles.
Once you have completed these tasks, speak again to Dúshlánach. Reward: Level 4 reputation with Beartach - The Merchant's shop, 1 mirror lens, and a Moon Garou pack.

Speak to Gaimbín within the Dunes of Uzzer, who will doubt your skills and warns you to leave as they needed to prepare for the event of Fuzan's Marking. Of course you'll be once again tasked to gain the clan's trust in order for the elder to reward you with the mirror lens.
Item(s) required: 1 spade of any kind, good weapons, armour and food to defend yourself from the KotHaar.

Speak to Lehran, who asks that you help him learn the truth of his ancestors, and he will vouch for you with the elder. He tells you that there are some ruins to the far south, long lost to the sands, and that the KotHaar have prevented him from travelling there himself. He reveals that the Forbidden Scrolls are meant to tell the truth about what happened to the Moon Garou centuries ago and not the stuff fed to them by their Elders. He asks you to go dig them up and bring back the scrolls to him, offering to also share the revelations with you if there are any.

Head to the area marked on your map, with your spade in your inventory/hotbar. To find the scrolls, you will need to locate areas that are similar to buried chests. Each Forbidden Scroll will be in one specific ruin, with two of them hidden behind locked gates. As there will be KotHaar and goats in the area, you will have to fight them in order to dig peacefully. There are four scrolls you will need to find, and they are the following: 'The Schism'; 'Sun Demon'; 'Old Kingdom'; 'Moon Goddess'
Once you have all four scrolls, return to Lehran. Give him the scrolls, and he will then give you 200 garou chit and the saga for your troubles.

Speak to Laguna, and they will tell you that they are on the market for a business partner and one with survival skills. They will tell you that there are four rocky spires around the pyramid close to this camp and that each spire holds a statue. They will ask you to go find each statue and note down the inscribed passages. Each passage, woven together, will form a saga. They will give you a book and remind you to note down the passages at the rocky spires.

Head towards the area marked on your map. You will find towering rocky spires around the Pyramid, and you must interact with them. Some of these statues are hidden in caves blocked by sandstone nodes, and others are protected by either KotHaar or kalphites. Inspect each statue to gain a piece of the saga. Once you have collected enough pieces of the saga, you will then need to follow a direction pointing towards a specific direction. Head to the spire with the Nightmare Crucible of Humilitation entrance, and the last ancient garou statue contains the full saga.

Once you have the complete saga, return to Laguna. They will congratulate you on finishing the saga and would enjoy performing at Fuzan's Mark Day, but for now, they will sing praises of your deeds to the elder. They also remark that you are free to unlock and explore the gateways as you see fit. Note: You will gain a Crucible Engram of Humiliation for completing this segment.
Item(s) requires: Good weapons, armour and food to better defend yourself against wandering enemies.

Speak to Shangruuh and he will inquire why the Uzzer garou have to be so insufferable. He says that he came here to trade goods, but was told that the clan were busy preparing for Mark Day. He'll ask you to convince each council member to abandon the tradition of Mark Day

There will be three green circles on your map. North of the camp, you'll need to find Brialka the historian councillor. South of the camp, you will find Chirot the Broker Councillor and Alabrais the Science Councillor. Each one will need to be convinced on abandoning Mark Day.
Follow the dialogue options in order for each councillor to secure their vote.
Alabrais the Science Councillor: Fuzan's aim is to control you, like his KotHaar. There is only evidence Fuzan destroys. Fuzan's constant is control of others
Brialka the Historian Councillor: You're making a choice that will affect generations. A garou alliance would make us stronger. The garou have always united to survive
Chirot the Broker Councillor: Fuzan's actions have cost you money. Before or after Fuzan takes his cut? Fuzan will steal what you wish to steal
Once you're done, return to the camp and speak to the elder. Rewards: 1 Moon Garou pack, mirror lens and level 4 in Iasadair - The Merchant's shop.
Item(s) required: Good weapons, armour, and food.
Visit Fuzan/Strategies for a guide to fighting Fuzan.

Speak to Icthlarin and he will say that there is little time to waste and that we must repair the mirrors. He informs you that he has positioned them carefully and believes they are directed at Fuzan's Lens, which is a dragonkin relic that protects both his volcano and powers his Mark. That belief, he says, will be tested now and prays to Elidnis for help if he's wrong. Interact with each of the mirrors to repair them fully and they will create a beam of concentrated sunlight directly towards Fuzan's tower. This is where you will be able to enter the Fight Caves and work your way towards Fuzan. Note: The activity you will enter will only have the "Trials of Fuzan" mode by default. As this activity is not safe, you will lose your items and respawn at your bed.

Head towards The Burning Spire and interact with the volcanic gateway at the base of Fuzan's Volcano. This will let you enter the Fight Caves and you must interact with the podium in the area to start the fight. Fight and survive through all ten waves of the trial and you will unlock the path to Fuzan's Lair. Interact with the door to Fuzan's Lair and you will be able to fight Fuzan. Defeat him and obtain his head.
Once you get his head, return to Icthlarin.

name: Regicide
description: Take the fight to Kuldra, and end this once and for all.
location: Interact with the Dragon Gate north of the Fractured Plains.

steps.text: To start this quest, players must have completed Icthlarin's Little Helper. After that, head back into the Fractured Plains and head north-west of Velgar's Rise. You will soon come across a Dragon Gate that will take you into the Scorned Wilderness. Interact with the gate and it will tell you that the blood of the four seal the gate. It will then tell you that the lord of the skies has fallen, Xikotal slain by Kuldra, Velgar's cruelty no longer infects the earth, Imaru finally rests in peace, and Fuzan's flames have been extinguished. Choose the option to journey into the Scorned Wilderness. Note: This will play the narrative trailer for the Scorned Wilderness.

Once you pass through the gate, the journey begins. Speak to Zilyana in Rasthin's Rest. She explains that she was sent there by Saradomin to deal with the threat, but requires your aid, as getting closer to Kuldra's lair weakens her. Zilyiana mentions that the location you are in makes a perfect base, it is advised that you build a new base here so that you can return after using a checkpoint, rest, craft and so on. After you have set up a base here, speak to Zilyana to continue to the first location.
Speak to Zilyana, and start the raid, you will be transported to Dragontail Vines. Note: For a strategy guide, see Scorned Wilderness. You'll need to clear the raid in order to complete the quest.
After defeating Kuldra, Zilyana will transport you back to Rasthin's Rest, where she will inform you that due to the veil, their deeds will go unnoticed for now. You are rewarded for your help.
steps.section: Part II: Death of a Queen

rewards: Full access to the Scorned Wilderness raid, including Kuldra's Sanctum.
Each time you complete a run, you will be forced to start again in Dragontail Vines.
After the quest, players can take Lougrim's Staff into Umbral Sands and speak to Ancamairon - Alcarrid Elder to receive the Lougrim Memorial Shrine furniture reward.

name: Growing Pains
description: Learn the basics of the Farming skill from the Wise Old Man.
location: Create the wooden watering can or the wooden spade in the crafting table interface.

steps.text: Make and receive either the wooden watering can or the wooden spade in your inventory. This will trigger a quest to start talking to the Wise Old Man at Bramblemead Valley, where he will give you the basics of the Farming skill. Ensure that at least one inventory space is available to receive the wheat seeds.

After talking to the Wise Old Man, create an ash farming plot and dig the plot whilst wielding the wooden spade. Dig five times, and you will receive at least three weeds and 3 Farming experience. It is recommended to store the weeds inside a compost bin to create compost for future plots. After digging the wheat plot, place the wheat seeds in your inventory (or equip the seeds) and left-click on the plot. You will receive 5 Farming experience for planting the wheat seeds. After spreading the seeds, you will need to water the wheat plot at each stage by equipping a full watering can. You can fill your watering can by pressing the F key on a pond of water. Water the wheat plot five times until you see a check mark at the bottom of the watering icon. You will need to wait half an in-game day (12 minutes client-side) for the wheat chute to grow into a wheat stalk.

Once the wheat chute grows into a wheat stalk, water the plot five times again. At any time during the process, not watering the plant after six in-game hours after the next phase will result in the wheat chute becoming diseased. You will not be able to create plant cure, so you will have to start again.

After waiting another in-game day, the wheat stalk will turn into harvestable wheat. Harvest the wheat before talking to the Wise Old Man again, and he will reward you with a pack of Farming supplies.

name: Shrimp Catcher
description: The Wise Old Man has some tips on how to grow as an amateur angler.
location: Speak to the Wise Old Man in Bramblemead Valley after creating a fishing net.

steps.text: To start this quest, create a coarse net at the crafting table. This will trigger the quest for you to speak to the Wise Old Man in Bramblemead Valley. Speak to him and choose option 2. This will make him remark about how you made yourself a very useful tool (remarking about the net) and remember in his very distant youth about spending countless hours catching something in a local pond with a net and how the owners weren't happy. He then says about how you can find yourself a nice spot to relax and wile away the dull hours of daylight between adventures and to challenge yourself to finding that single pristine fish. He continues about how he hadn't eaten a good fish in ages and asks you to catch him a sardine in the Brynmoor waters, but tells you that you'd need to use a fishing rod to catch one and craft bait to aid you. Note: This will start the next objective, which is to capture a raw sardine.

He then begins to tell you that you can boil, roast, stew, and make a lot of delicious meals out of them. He also says that if you find really nice ones, you can put them on display. After this, you will be presented with four options to discuss fishing.
Item(s) required: Any fishing net, Ash Rod.
In order to get to the sardines, you will need to get some Fishing levels.

Head to any nearby net fishing spot and stand within it while wielding your net to start trawling to capture raw shrimp, and you'll unlock shrimp bait. Keep capturing shrimp using your net until you reach level 3, where you'll unlock the ability to create Fishing Rods. Go to your crafting table and use 1 ash log and 1 coarse thread to make an ash rod, then with the shrimp you've caught, create some shrimp bait (each shrimp gives 1 bait).
Once you have your fishing rod and bait, head to a nearby rod fishing spot and fish there.

Unlike with net fishing, you will need to equip both your fishing rod and bait to start rod fishing. Hold down your cast button (LMB by default) and release it to start fishing, but it is possible to miss the spot if you cast too weakly or too strongly. Once you've successfully cast into the fishing spot, you will need to use your strafe left/right buttons (A and D buttons respectively) to tire out the fish. A bar will appear above the bottom-middle of your screen that will gradually disappear. If the bar remains blue, you will begin to tire out the fish, but if it is red, that means the fish is stronger and reeling in the fish will consume greater amounts of stamina. When the fish is tired out, an option will appear to reel in the fish.

When the bar is empty, you will have caught a fish. This can either be a sardine or a trout. Note: Fishing will consume your stamina rapidly. If you do not reel in your fish quickly before depleting your stamina, your fish will escape.
Once you have caught your sardine, head back to the Wise Old Man.

Bringing the sardine you've caught back to him, the Wise Old Man will remark how you've caught a wonderful delicious sardine and how it brings back old memories. Before cooking the sardine like how his grampa used to, he rewards you for a job well done.

name: Restless Ghosts
description: Lay to rest the spirits of the lost expedition members.
location: Interact with the Crumbling Well in the Ruined Village, northwest of the Wise Old Man.

steps.text: In the ruined village north-west of the Wise Old Man, locate and interact with the crumbling well to receive the ghostspeak amulet. (Note: The amulet goes to the quest-item tab of your inventory instead of your basic inventory.) Next, speak with four ghosts throughout the Bramblemead Valley and Whispering Swamp. The ghosts are only visible from sunset to sunrise..
Warren's spirit is located in a dilapidated house in the south-west corner of the ruined village.
Lazina's spirit is located in a broken house to the south-east of the windmill in the Temple Woods and is along the walking path.

Finn's spirit is located inside a cave blocked by thorny vines to the south-east of the Wise Old Man. Cast Windstep to reach the lip of the cave, and then use a logging axe to destroy the thorns blocking the entrance.
Kay's spirit is located in a ruined house in the Whispering Swamp along the border with the Bramblemead Valley.

After meeting with all four ghosts, travel to the Remembrance Shrine located outside at the south-west corner of the church where players first spawn. The shrine is a large, stone flower vase atop a stone sculpture. Interact with the statue and select each option to "remember" all four ghosts.

name: Goblin Diplomacy
description: Zanik needs you to stop a prophecy before it's too late.
location: Speak to Zanik on the ridge in Bramblemead Valley.

steps.text: Zanik will tell the player they sense the presence of a prophecy in the Outlook Ruins to the north-east of her, as well as in the Adventurer's Guild to the south. Both areas are overrun with goblins, so make sure you're properly equipped to take on the challenge with health potions, food, and water.
It is recommended that you place a lodestone at Zanik's location, as you'll have to come back to Zanik to complete the quest. This way, you can easily fast travel back to the location.

You can choose to either search the nearby ruins first or the Adventurer's Guild first. Both contain a reliquary containing the Bandosian amulet, but only one can be looted. The amulet in the location you didn't check first ends up stolen by a garou druid.

The ruins' reliquary is tucked away in a corner, whereas the guild reliquary is blocked by thorny vines, requiring 20 Woodcutting to cut down. The guild is also more dangerous due to the number of goblins inhabiting it, so it's recommended to obtain the amulet from the ruins' reliquary. Both locations have a caged goblin outside. Bilegut can be found outside the Outlook Ruins, and Wormelbow can be found outside the Adventurer's Guild. When talking to either of them before obtaining a Bandosian amulet, they'll offer to tell you the exact location of the respective reliquary in exchange for a steak. This is optional, as the reliquaries can be found without their help.

Next, you'll need to head to whichever location you did not obtain the Bandosian amulet from. If you obtained the amulet from the ruins, then head to the guild, and if you obtained the amulet from the guild, then head to the ruins. You don't need to defeat all the goblins there—simply locate the caged goblin and eliminate the goblins around it. Once the area is clear, speak with the caged goblin to learn the whereabouts of the second Bandosian amulet. The goblin will reveal that a garou-beastman has taken the second amulet to a cave in the Whispering Swamp.

Now, you must head to the cave in the swamp where a garou druid is keeping the second Bandosian amulet. However, the journey is not quite straightforward. The cave is located at the very bottom of the swamp, so be sure you go down into the swamp safely first, and then search for the cave. Otherwise, you will be running above the cave location and won’t be able to find the entrance. Once you've located the cave entrance, enter to find the garou druid. Defeat the garou druid to obtain the second Bandosian amulet. The garou druid is quite strong and can inflict a potent poison. To defeat it more easily, use magic attacks at a distance, and be sure to dodge its poison thorns.
After obtaining both Bandosian amulets, return to Zanik. She will thank you for bringing the two amulets, and this will complete the quest. As a reward, Zanik will give you the goblin war banner.

name: Highlighting the Problem
description: Explore the RuneCrafting Guild to discover the means to craft a powerful magical weapon.
location: Interact with the statue of a wizard in the Runecrafting Guild in Bramblemead Valley.

steps.text: The statue requires a password. The password is found in the Thishepen Kara vault, found at the base of the cliff near the guild, in a room which requires Windstep to reach. You do not need to complete the whole vault; you can simply go for the password, which is found at a glowing blue statue hidden on an elevated path to your right in a room of four giant rats. The password is pthentorok.

Upon returning to the statue and giving it the password, a mysterious voice will talk to the player and give them a mysterious orb (uncharged). The player must then interact with three pedestals on the three towers surrounding the main tower in the guild. The player must use Windstep to reach the top of the towers, and can take advantage of surrounding rubble and other scenery.

After interacting with the three pedestals, the orb turns into the mysterious orb (charged), and the player must return to the first statue, which will then give the player the recipe for the staff of light, finishing the quest.

name: Granite Mauled
description: Uncover the secrets of Ashien's Watch.
location: Speak to Doric north-east of Fractured Plains.

steps.text: The quest can be started by talking to Doric north-east of Fractured Plains. Doric is located south of Ashien's Watch on a lookout with ruins on it. There's a broken bridge leading over to the other side as well. He will tell you that Ashien's Watch was where all the "valuable relics and supplies" were located during the time of the dragon, and he was looking for it. But he was chased away — and now he wants your help.

Once you have located and activated all four statues in Ashien's Watch, enter the Skeklac Kara vault. Make sure to bring forms of antipoison (cooked food with poison resistance or some weak antipoison potions), as there are putrid rats and poisonous gas bubbles that explode and poison you. Make sure to check for blind spots, as the gas bubbles are in many corners and can deal high damage to the player. Upon reaching the lever that opens the vault corruptor's doors, the corruptor can deal high damage and poison in addition to putrid rats in the area. It is recommended to use ranged weapons or magic to avoid getting hit.
After defeating the boss at the end, interact with the statue, and you will receive a blueprint. Bring the blueprint back to Doric for translation.

name: Heartstrings
description: Sing the bard's song of rememberance.
location: Interact with the memorial stone at the top of the hill at Fractured Plains.

steps.text: You can start this quest by interacting with a glowing blue memorial stone found next to a unique, large tree with blue leaves found in the Fractured Plains region. The tree is on top of where the first Fractured Plains dungeon is located. You can get to the top by casting the Windstep spell a few times up the rocks to the right of the cave where you access that dungeon. Upon searching the first memorial stone, players will receive a crystal seed in their quest inventory.

There are a total of 7 memorial stones to be found, all in an eastward direction from the first. All quest progression points are therefore next to the unique trees with memorial stones found next to them. From the first tree, proceed eastward to find the next tree. As these trees are located in the open area of the Fractured Plains, it is recommended to be ready for combat with several wolves and garou that you will encounter during the quest.
Reaching the final tree and singing the song will complete the quest.

name: Dog Days
description: Investigate the Garou and their rituals.
location: Speak to Vannaka at the centre of Stormtouched Highlands.

steps.text: Talk to Vannaka, who is standing under a cliff in the eastern part of the Highlands (see the image). He will tell you about the garou and ask you to investigate their rituals.
steps.section: Investigate the Garou and their rituals

steps.text: Go to the location of the lore book, beneath the wyrm corpse, and read it. It is advised to go around and approach from the north, as there are fewer enemies. There is a garou thane next to the book, but facing the opposite direction, so you can sneak there and read the book.
steps.section: Investigate the Garou and their rituals

steps.text: After you read the book, you have to defeat the Garou King and get his tainted token. Go to the castle in the north-west of the Highlands. Use Windstep as much as you can, to avoid as many enemies as you can. At the top of the hill, in the castle, you need to defeat the king, who is a thane, and his attacks are the same. It is suggested to cast Windstep onto the arches of the Garou King's ruined temple to safespot its attacks.

Go back to Vannaka after you get the token. He will tell you that the token is tainted and needs to be purified. Head north to the location of Lougrim's Shrine, kill the garou druids there, and use it. The shrine will tell you that for the ritual, you need 2 ram horns and 3 Shock Bulbs, so kill rams and wild lapulis vines until you have enough materials. Then, go back to the shrine and perform the ritual of purification to receive a purified token.
Go back to Vannaka and talk with him.

name: Cook's Assistant
description: Help Slopfinger in Ghornfell bake a memorable cake for Manktongue.
location: Speak to Slopfinger in the southwestern corner of the Fractured Plains.

steps.text: To start the quest, speak to Slopfinger, located in the south-west area of the Fractured Plains, near the border of the Stormtouched Highlands. Speaking to him, you learn that he is trying to make a cake, but his assistant, Manktongue, is ignoring him, so he asks you to assist him in showing that he can prove his worth as a chef. He'll ask you to collect 4 eggs, 6 wheats and 1 bucket of milk. The bucket of milk is the easiest ingredient; there is a cow just outside of the building within a pen. Interact with it and go through all the options, BUT do not milk it, as it will willingly give you milk.

For the rest of the ingredients, it is advised that you build a lodestone at the quest area so you can head over to Bramblemead Valley or Temple Woods to collect some eggs from chickens. Alternatively, you can chop down trees and get a bird nest. Killing goblins is required to collect wheat seeds, or looking through chests.

Once you collect all the ingredients, return to Slopfinger, and he will have you bake the cake for him. After baking the cake, speak to him again, and he will ask that you speak to Manktongue and show him the cake. Speak to Slopfinger one last time to complete the quest.

name: Animal Magnetism
description: Create the Ava's Accumulator
location: Speak to Manktongue in the southwestern corner of the Fractured Plains.

steps.text: To start the quest, speak to Manktongue, who will inform you that he found a message in a bottle in the water. Reading it will reveal that it is a message from Ava with the ingredients on how to craft her accumulator. Knowing the needed ingredients, you are asked to retrieve each of the following: 1 undead chicken, a bundle of undead twigs, and a magnet, which requires 1 iron bar and 5 law runes. If you already have the iron and law runes, take them to Pulpknuckle. He is located in the same cabin upstairs, who will create the magnet for you.

The undead chicken is located within the Stormtouched Highlands, directly north of the quest area. Enter the region, go up the hill, then search for an iron ore node on the wall. The chicken will be there (map on the bottom right). The Twig is located south of the entrance to Bloodblight Swamp (map on the bottom right). There is an undead tree; to get the twig, you will need to interact with it. Warning: An abyssal demon is known to roam around this area. Be cautious.
After you gather all the ingredients, return to Manktongue, who will create the device for you.

rewards: Ava's accumulator and the ability to create more.

name: A Room With A Garou
description: An elder garou wants you to build a home that his late wife would be proud of.
location: Speak to Caratacus in the northwestern corner of the Fractured Plains.

steps.text: Caratacus laments the passing of his wife, Cliodhina, who wanted to live in the area. He'll ask you to help him build a home, as he's unable to do so due to his blindness.

You can build the house however you like, but to finish the quest quickly, building 4 walls and a roof within the floor space is recommended. This requires a minimum of 20 ash logs, where players can create: 4 walls; 1 45° roof
Once completed, speak to him again.

items.name: Ash logs
items.note: or another building material to create a house around Caratacus.

name: A Melody Remembered
description: A jewellery box in Ghornfell plays a haunting melody, but it cannot complete its song.
location: Interact with a music box on a desk located in Stormtouched Highlands, south of the Garou king's fortress

steps.text: Upon finding the music box, located in a ruined building south of the Garou King's fortress, following the road to it, there is a music box on a desk. Upon interacting with it, you will be asked to give it the following items: An inspiring ring of Runecrafting; Later an amulet of Magic (not to be confused with the inspiring amulet of Magic.)

items.name: Inspiring ring of Runecrafting
items.note: or 1 clay mould, 2 silver bars, 2 opals, and 3 vault shards

items.note: or 1 clay mould, 2 gold bars, 2 silver bars, 4 sapphires, and 6 vault shards

items.name: Jeweler's bench
items.note: or 12 oak planks, 8 ground sandstone, 2 gold bars, 2 silver bars, and 1 vault core

rewards: Includes the recipe to crafting more

name: The Great Body Robbery
description: Assist Dr Fenkenstrain in acquiring a new body. FOR SCIENCE!
location: Talk to Doctor Fenkenstrain in the Bloodblight Swamp.

steps.text: To start this quest, speak to Doctor Fenkenstrain in the Bloodblight Swamp. He will be in his tower next to the garou camp around the bloodwood tree and on the same floor as the sanguine urn.

When you start talking to him, he will remark that they called him mad and that he'll show them. After a minute, he'll finally notice you and ask who you are. Choosing any option will result in him not caring who you are and asking you if you can help him out with something. He wants you to go collect some arms, legs, and that sort of stuff from graves all around the swamp. This will lead you to collect three items: Arms, Legs, Torso.
Locate graves by their headstones in the Bloodblight Swamp and use your spade/shovel near them to dig up a coffin. Interact with the coffin to collect the parts.
Human Torso: Near the abyssal demon. In the centre of three trees.
Goblin Legs: North of the torso coffin. Between two trees.
Garou Arms: Near the northern entrance to the Bloodblight Swamp.

Once you have all of the items, return to the doctor. Speak to him, and he will make a dumb pun about your unusual collection of body parts before asking you to place the parts on the examination table. Interact with the nearby examination table and speak to the doctor once more. He will ask you to examine the parts, and he will then ask you to bring him one weak antipoison potion, one weak Focused Attack potion, and one weak Lumberjack potion. Collect the potions and return to the doctor.
Use the potions (after speaking to the doctor again), and he will say that the body needs lightning, giving you an empty vial. You will need to get struck by lightning to fill the vial.

You can either wait for a thunderstorm event in nearly any of the regions, or head to the Stormtouched Highlands and wait to get struck by lightning. Once you have the Lightning-in-a-bottle, head back to the doctor.

Speak to him again, and he will ask you to put his head on the incomplete body on the examination table. Interact with the body to place the doctor's head on it, and then use the lighting-in-a-bottle on the nearby pylon. Once you interact with the nearby pylon, the doctor's head on the body will swap with the nearby chicken's head.
Speak to the doctor on the chicken's body to learn that he miscalculated. He will then give you your reward to distract you while he works out his tricky situation.

rewards: Recipe to build a Lightning rod

name: Even More Restless Ghosts
description: Help Zanik lay some spirits to rest by finding them and completing their unfinished business.
location: Speak to Zanik at Fellhollow.

steps.text: Begin the quest by speaking with Zanik in Bleakfields Valley. She is located in the ruins to the east of Cathan at the three standing stones and north of a nearby spectral door.
Note: All four God Shrines must be activated to disable the barrier surrounding the village.

In Emberwood, travel to the ruin village previously surrounded by a magic barrier. In the outskirts of the village, near the north-east, are the ruins of a small home where the windswept ghost is located. Build a house consisting of any square foundation (under the ghost), four walls, and an enclosed roof around the windswept ghost. Talk to the windswept ghost again to complete the section. The door of the house must be closed for it to complete.
In Hope's Fall, travel to the ruin gates located north of the dragon spire. Speak with the reminiscing ghost and gift a Clay Decoration to complete the section.

Between the Lake of Lost Souls and Coalridge Pass, just north-east of the most eastern area of the tainted river, lies the paint-spattered ghost. Talk to the ghost and it will describe the location of the sketchbook their husband took with him.

Travel north-east to a set of ruins that lie at the mouth of the cave. Enter the cave and clear a grouping of granite deposits atop a coal node to the left side to uncover a skeleton and the sketchbook. Interact with the sketchbook and then return to speak with the paint-spattered ghost again.
Return to Zanik in Bleakfields Valley to finish the quest.

items.name: Mining equipment of power level 4 or higher (i.e., iron pickaxe or runes for Rocksplosion)
Building materals for a square foundation, four walls, and a roof (e.g., 36 ash logs)

name: The Wild Hunt
description: Help Vannaka safeguard Fellhollow's nature spirits, by hunting them down in willow groves and collecting their hearts.
location: Speak to Vannaka

steps.text: To begin this quest, speak to Vannaka who can be found west of Cathan's location in the Bleakfields Valley region of Fellhollow. He will explain to you how nature spirits are dying out due to the nature of this region and he tasks you to find nature spirits and defeat them to collect their primordial hearts. These spirits can only be found in Willow groves at or around the western area of Fellhollow and will look like white glowing terrorbirds. If you aren't up to looking all over for them, you can find one near the northwestern area of the druid's circle in the Emberwood area, one in the Dragon's Run area, and another in the southern section of Witchwillow Range.
Once you have all three hearts, return to Vannaka who will then use an old garou ritual from before Kuldra's reign to imbue you with the essence of these spirits.

rewards: Access to a terrorbird mount (press the ALT key)
50x soul fragments (for any extra hearts you have)
