name: Seeking Salvation
description: Find the statues to gain entrance to the vault and uncover the secrets that lie within.
location: Speak to Doric east of the Lake of Lost Souls, inside a cave.

steps.text: The quest can be started by talking to Doric east of the Lake of Lost Souls, inside a cave ruin near the entrance to the Skekven Kara vault. He'll inform you that the vault door is sealed by magic and requires you to unlock it. To unlock it, look for four dragonkin statues; activate them to unlock the door.
One statue is located outside the cave entrance, before entering the cave.
A statue can be found south-west of Doric, behind the giant pillar. If it is too dark, bring out your torch for better lighting.
One is located on the top of the pillar, directly west of Doric. You will require the Windstep spell or build some foundation and/or stairs.
The final statue is located north-west of Doric; there will be some rot. Use Windstep or build some stairs at the location. There will be a cracked wall; you will need a pickaxe to break it.

Once you have located and activated all four statues, you can enter the Skekven Kara vault. Make sure to bring plenty of cooked food and drinks (such as clean water or infusions) as there are multiple enemies within.

Inside the Skekven Kara vault, proceed in the entry room to the central staircase. At the second highest level of the stairs, an opening in the wall south of the staircase can be reached by using Windstep. In this cavern, interact with the dragonkin statue to learn the secrets, which Doric can translate.

items.name: Air rune
items.note: to cast Windstep or resources to build foundations and stairs to certain statues

items.name: Iron pickaxe
items.note: or better

items.name: Torch
items.note: or the spell Fire Spirit (if too dark or in a cave)

rewards: This also unlocks the permanent option to purchase more crystals from Death's Exchange for 25 soul fragments each.
The recipe to craft a salve amulet

name: Doric's Quest
description: Doric is looking for rare weapons in Fellhollow.
location: Speak to Doric

steps.text: Speak to Doric after completing Seeking Salvation, he will requests that you collect several rare weapons from stories he believe originated from Fellhollow!
He'll first ask for the undead ranger's bow, enter the Skekven Kara vault and locate a dragonkin effigy. Once you found the recipe, craft the bow and return to Doric.
If you already own the item, you do not need to craft it, the item will be kept.
Next he'll ask for the necromancer's staff, which can be found in a dragonkin effigy in Vekchenven Kara. Once you found the recipe, craft the staff and return to Doric.
If you already own the item, you do not need to craft it, the item will be kept.

The final search will be the shadow sword, which the recipe can be found by killing Ulgo the Zogre. The recipe is a rare drop from zogres, so you might need to kill them more than once. They are located in a cave within Emberwood, Eastern side of Silverthorn Keep and in Vekchenven Kara as the vault's boss. Once you find the recipe, craft it and return to Doric.
If you already own the item, you do not need to craft it, the item will be kept.

rewards: 1 The recipe to make the zombie axe

name: Letters for the Dead
description: Postie Pete needs some help finding and delivering some stolen letters around Bleakfields Valley in Fellhollow.
location: Speak to Postie Pete in the Forgotten Temple.

steps.text: Speak to Postie Pete and select option 2 to talk about this quest. He will ask you (while making a bone pun) if you can help him with something. Accepting his question, Postie Pete will mention how, by RPDT standards, he made a big mistake by misplacing some posts. He will tell you that, as he looked in his bag, someone came by and nabbed three letters. This mysterious thief then fled into Fellhollow. He then tells you that, after taking a quick look, he noticed someone shifty near the little house just outside the entrance to Fellhollow. He will then ask you to take a look for him.

Walk slightly north-east of the entrance to Fellhollow (where you find Ravanna's third journal) and you will find a suspicious skeleton sitting down in a chair. Talk to it and you will find that they are animate in a similar manner to Postie Pete. They mention being bone idle for the moment and hating puns, but asks you what you want. You have the following options:
Click on option 3, the skeleton will reveal that they haven't gotten any letters. This little accidental reveal will give you more dialogue options.

From this point, the skeleton will continue to gaslight you. They will say that you had already mentioned it before (No, you didn't) and, thus, open up new dialogue options. Choose option 1 in this new dialogue and the gaslighting continues. By choosing option 1 one more time, the skeleton will concede the gaslighting fight and give you one of the letters. Take this letter to a nearby red deposit box northwest of Vannaka's camp in Bleakfields Valley and deliver it.

Upon delivering it, a dialogue box will open up to inform you that when you posted the letter, you found a strange leaf that appears to partially fade into the spirit realm. It will then hint to you going into a spectral door. Note: This will make the Suspicious Skeleton turn into uninteractable scenery once you acquire the letter from them. The relevant postage deposit box will vanish upon closing out of the dialogue box.

Head directly east of Cathan's location (at the standing stones) to a glowing wall torch with a letter mail satchel dangling down. Interact with it to acquire one of the missing letters. This letter will want you to deliver it to the standing stones in Bleakfields Valley. Immediately head towards Cathan's location and, before going up to see him, the red mail deposit box will be on the left side of the trail. Deliver the postage and a dialogue option will appear. It will tell you that you discovered a small patch of ghostly looking fluff and it looks like unspun wool. This will prompt you to look for the former owner.

Find a ghostly sheep named "Shaun" to retrieve a ghostly letter. He will be almost directly west of where the last postage deposit box was. Upon receiving the letter, you must take the letter to Imaru's Tower. As there are plenty of Rotsworn undead here, you will need to be careful.

Upon arriving at Imaru's Tower, another red postage deposit box will be in front of her tower off to the right. When you deliver the letter you obtained from Shaun, you will then need to return to Postie Pete. When you choose the option to continue the quest, Pete will thank you to delivering the letters and introduce you to the numbskull who caused the problem in the first place. It turns out that said numbskull was, in fact, Postie Pete's sibling and junior RPDT employee Parcel Pete. While Parcel Pete wanted to help out, it bungled everything up. Postie Pete will inform you that, due to Parcel Pete's "help", he put him on report and filing his PIP. He will then give you a decorative item that, in the future, will enable you to render further aid to him delivering letters.

rewards: Access to an expanding and repeatable activity.

needs.recommended: Lodestone access to Fellhollow; Food, drink, and gear

name: What Remains is Written
description: Find the stolen knowledge and return it to its owner. I'm sure nothing bad will happen because of it.
location: Speak to Abraxus The Eternal in Coalridge Pass.

steps.text: Speak to Abraxus The Eternal in Coalridge Pass just north of the fork in the road while wearing the full necromancer's gear. He will assume, at least from your clothes, that you are an apprentice of his and will require your aid. He will introduce himself quite arrogantly that you stand in the presence of "Abraxus The Eternal, master of necromancy, Keeper of secrets, both occult and arcane" and inform you that locals have ransacked his library and his most precious tomes have been spread across the eastern sub-regions. He tasks you to find them and bring them back, but not to read any of them. He claims that your mind is too young and too limited to contain the dreaded secrets within.
To find all of the books you need to return to Abraxus, you will need to look through every corner of the Silverthorn Keep region. Here is some books you can find:
steps.section: Hunt For Knowledge Pt. I: Ancient Tomes

steps.text: The Pride of the Avernic. Located in the second level of Silverthorn Keep next to a archery target scene.
steps.section: Hunt For Knowledge Pt. I: Ancient Tomes

steps.text: The Importance of Chaos. Located just north-west of the ominous gateway. It's lying on a small incline on the south side of a small tower amidst a gateway ruin (which can be seen on the map). It is on the south-western end of the ruin.
steps.section: Hunt For Knowledge Pt. I: Ancient Tomes

steps.text: Aetheric Fundamentals, a Primordial Primer. Located across the stone bridge in Silverthorn Keep where you find the curse fragment. There is a green dragon spawn right next to this.
steps.section: Hunt For Knowledge Pt. I: Ancient Tomes

steps.text: The Wrath of Baba Potterington. Located in a crumbled stone house near a nature grove north of the 'sil' of Silverthorn Keep on the map.
steps.section: Hunt For Knowledge Pt. I: Ancient Tomes

steps.text: Leonard the Bound. Located north-west of the ominous gateway within the ruins that serve as the transition area between the Lake of Lost Souls and Silverthorn Keep areas. The book is on top of the western side of the gate, laying on a pedestal. There will be skeletal hoplites and archers in this area.
steps.section: Hunt For Knowledge Pt. I: Ancient Tomes

steps.text: Once you have all of the books, return to and speak to Abraxus.
steps.section: Hunt For Knowledge Pt. I: Ancient Tomes

steps.text: Donning your necromancer's gear, speak to Abraxus. He will be excited to see that you have retrieved his books and hopes you didn't peek at them, but there is more to uncover. He mentions how three of his scrolls were taken from him and how you must reclaim them. He will say that the first scroll was taken from him by Blightscale, a green dragon, and that you must make a lesson of her hubris. The second scroll was taken by Ulgo, a zogre, who can be found nearby. The last one to find was taken by a rival of his called Razlem, the Deranged.
steps.section: Hunt of Knowledge Pt. II: The Secret Scrolls

steps.text: Eventide - A New Spawn. Defeat Razlem, the Deranged. He wanders a small ruin directly east of the ominous gateway. You will find the scroll on top of a desk near him.
steps.section: Hunt of Knowledge Pt. II: The Secret Scrolls

steps.text: Coclear Malificarum. Defeat Ulgo the zogre in Coalridge Pass. It will be right next to the chest in his hoard. Ulgo is just north of the "Coalridge Pass" label on the map.
steps.section: Hunt of Knowledge Pt. II: The Secret Scrolls

steps.text: The Binding of Ib. Defeat Blightscale. Blightscale is a green dragon located at the south side of the cliffs leading up to the Silverthorn Keep, north-east of the ominous gateway. She is immediately past some willow trees and a small set of ruins. There is a spectral door in the small clearing where he's located. The scroll is found near some bones in the clearing.
steps.section: Hunt of Knowledge Pt. II: The Secret Scrolls

steps.text: Once you have all the scrolls, don your necromancer's gear and speak to Abraxus. He will commend you for your efforts and say that you have earned his respect, which no one has earned for centuries. He will then remark that he isn't foolish enough to believe you can be rewarded only with his respect, as he gives you something that may serve you well. He will then excuse himself to mail a pebble to an old friend of his and hopes that they accept it, so he can haunt them for a while, as he is tired of the view.
steps.section: Hunt of Knowledge Pt. II: The Secret Scrolls

name: Mirror, Mirror
description: Help free a mysterious figure from their mirror prison.
location: Speak to the mirror west of the Emberwood Village

steps.text: To begin this quest, speak to the mirror west of the Emberwood Village past the green dragon. You will hear crying audio when you first approach them.

They will be surprised to see a real living person in Fellhollow since their imprisonment decades ago and recount how a terrible necromancer sealed them within the mirror. While this necromancer first taunted them with the ritual needed to release them, they claim it is simple to do and shouldn't take long. They will ask you to collect the required items for them to start the ritual.

For the ritual, they need some dragon blood, a copy of their spellbook found within Emberwood Village, and some spectral silver thread. Note: You can kill the nearby green dragon or some dragon wolves for the dragon blood.

For the copy of their spellbook, go into Emberwood Village (you will need to either have gotten past this point in the Withering Heights quest or reactivated the statues on a new world) and find the destroyed windmill. Inside, you will find a bedraggled spellbook. Pick this up as you will need it.

For the spectral silver thread, you will need to go find Edna's skeleton within Dragon's Run. To find that, look for a crumbling stone house near a willow grove and a rundown gateway. Her skeleton will be sitting back to a corner on the right side. Interact with the skeleton and the spirit of Edna will inform you that, to make the spectral silver thread, you will need to bring them the following items: 1 silver bar; 1 fine thread; 1 sacred oil; 6 soul fragments

Once you have all these items, bring them back to Edna. Once you hand over the ingredients, the skeleton will perform a series of gestures which will be too quick for you to follow with your eyes. After a moment, the skeleton will hand you the spectral silver thread and return to rest. Once that is done, head back to the mirror.

Speak to the figure in the mirror once again, and they will be happy that you collected all of the reagents. While they will take them off your hands, they mention that you can press them up to the glass, and they will get them. Hand over the reagents, and they will remark about how, while they prepare the ritual on their side, they will need you to tether them back to your reality by rekindling their memories. The reason why is that, due to their age, they have too many memories and need to put some of them safely away. They left a few of their memories as memorial candles within each region they have visited and, for each candle lit, a memory will return to help anchor them into reality. The figure will give you a small piece of their soul to help ignite these memorial candles and, once each candle is lit, they will be to return.

This is where you will need to visit each region of Ashenfall to light the candles. On your map, the candle areas will be highlighted blue. Here is the list of each candle location within the regions:
Fellhollow: Right next to the mirror.

Ghornfell: Fractured Plains: Next to a small lake south-south-east of Velgar's Rise. The lake will contain floating rune essence. Stormtouched Highlands: A bit north-east of the garou castle at the edge of a cliff. It will be along the edge of the territory. Bloodblight Swamp: West of the garou encampment leading towards the bloodwood tree.
Brynmoor: Whispering Swamp: Next to a giant swamp tree on the third most western island from the vault. Bramblemead Valley: South of the Crasorak Kara vault, atop the cliff and behind the rocks.
With the final memory candle lit, head back to the mirror.

Speak to the figure in the mirror, and it will inform you that it will get started on the ritual, but their freedom will take roughly a week or so. While you could wait to see what happens, they inform you that you don't need to stick around that long. You have done everything needed to help free them from their reflective prison and give you a reward for your assistance.

rewards: 1x Ulv's longbow and the subsequent recipe

name: Biohazard
description: Investigate the strange corruption afflicting the residents of Dowdun Reach.
location: Speak to Zanik under The Approach, or collect a corrupted essence sample from corrupted ravens

steps.text: You can start this quest in one of two ways: speak to Zanik, who is beneath The Approach, or simply collect a corrupted essence sample from any corrupted raven in Dowdun Reach. Either way, Zanik will ask you to gather 10 corrupted essence samples from corrupted ravens scattered across the region. Refer to the map on the right for their locations.
Once you return to Zanik with all 10 samples, she will ask you to gather three additional items: Dragon blood, unholy water, and a twilight lily.
Dragon blood: can be obtained by slaying any dragon in Dowdun Reach, or from a dragon wolf if you want to head back to Fellhollow and hunt easier enemies.
Twilight lily: found in The Lake, glowing blue in front of an anima tree. The Lake is just south-west of Zanik.

Unholy water: behind The Cathedral, near three Zamorakian acolytes, a mage of Zamorak, and two elite Black Knights. Look for a statue with water flowing from its hands. You do not need to fight any of the enemies here — you can sneak to the fountain south-west of them to collect it.
Bring all three items back to Zanik. She will ask you to track down the source of the corruption.

Head to The Nexus and make your way to The Grand Hall. Use windstep to climb up to the roof (beware of a Black Knight sniper and a Black Knight guardian), and you'll find a corrupted chicken named Putrilius.
Complete the dialogue with Putrilius.
Return to Zanik and tell her what you found on the roof of the Grand Hall. She thanks you for your help with investigating the corruption and rewards you for your efforts.

name: Wanted!
description: Hunt down the Beast Tamers
location: Speak to Vannaka in Dowdun Reach.

steps.text: Speak to Vannaka, who can be found by the tent in front of The Library shortly after entering Dowdun Reach. He explains that three Black Knights — the Rat Master, the Hound Master, and the Summoner — have each gained control over different demonic creatures, and asks you to retrieve their training journals.
Vannaka can provide background on each of the three beast tamers if you ask. The three targets can be tackled in any order. Each is a genuine combat encounter with multiple enemies, so come prepared.

Head south-west from Vannaka to The Menagerie; you'll need to cross The Library and defeat the lesser blue dragon guarding the entrance to The Menagerie before making your way further. Rat Master Skrexis can be found on a ledge at the end of the lower path, surrounded by his hellrats. He was once a reclusive knight with terrible hygiene habits who attracted vermin wherever he went — the corruption has only deepened that bond.

Defeat him and his pack of hellrats. Once the area is clear, look for his journal sitting on a rock directly behind where he was standing, to the left of the statue. Interact with it to read or take some pages.

Make your way to The Garrison and descend to the lower floors of the forward building. Philius Rexiton, the Hound Master, was a noble with a love for dogs before the corruption took hold. Now he commands a whole pack of hellhounds in the dungeons below.

This is a crowded fight — you'll be dealing with Rexiton and his entire pack at once. Try to manage the hellhounds while keeping pressure on the Hound Master himself. After defeating them, the journal is in the central kennel, lying on the table.

Head south from Vannaka to The Cathedral and descend into the crypts below. His quarters are immediately adjacent to The Lake, which is the closest nodestone. Lester Flament, the Summoner, wanders here with Delrom, his eerily loyal demon. Flament was reputedly odious and unpopular even among the Black Knights.
Delrom hits hard, so don't underestimate this fight. Once the Summoner is defeated, pick up his journal from the plinth at the back wall, below the demon gargoyle.

With all three journals in hand, return to Vannaka. He eagerly examines the journals, expecting to find dark rites and sinister spells — only to discover that the beast tamers' secret was treating the creatures kindly.
Vannaka hands you a trinket to help deal with demonic creatures, remarking that there's no time for the friendlier approach.

rewards: Corroded jewellery vestige, required to create the unholy symbol.

name: What's Theirs is Mine!
description: Help Doric track down the mage that stole his keepsake, by unlocking portals around Dowdun Reach.
location: Speak to Doric in The Nexus in Dowdun Reach.

steps.text: Speak to Doric in The Nexus. He explains that a red-robed wizard barged into him and stole a small bronze dog on a keychain — a keepsake made by his son, Boric, and one of his most treasured possessions. The mage fled through one of the nearby portals, and Doric caught a brief glimpse of pews and religious fixtures before the thief vanished.

Doric asks you to chase the mage through the portals and recover his keepsake. He points out that following the trail should also help you activate the nodestones scattered around Dowdun Reach, opening up fast-travel routes through the keep.
The three locations can be visited in any order. Each is in hostile territory, so come prepared.

Make your way to The Cathedral region in Dowdun Keep. The nodestone here sits on the north-west wing of the building and can't be reached from inside — enter the cathedral and turn right, then follow the outer walkway around the side. Look for a section where the parapets are missing and use Windstep to reach the upper ledge where the nodestone and notes are located.

The scrawled notes on a nearby table are incoherent ramblings about the nature of portal magic — the mage was studying how the nodestones in the keep work without runes, drawing power from the Dreaming Stone instead.
There's no sign of the mage himself, but the nearby nodestone crackles with lingering energy. Activate it and return to Doric.

Back at The Nexus, Doric reports that you just missed the mage — the red-robed wizard ran right past him again, waving a great spiky staff around "without fear of poking anyone's eyes out." This time the portal showed chains, cells, and angry-looking knights. A garrison, perhaps.

Head to The Garrison and make your way to the building with four turrets on the norther face of the fortress. Inside, look for the mage's schematics sitting atop a crate near the nodestone, on the first floor. These notes describe some form of emotion-based magic — an attempt to draw energy from suffering and channel it into a source of great pain.
Again, no mage in sight. Activate the nodestone and return to Doric.
Doric tells you the mage sprinted past him once more, and this time the portal showed glowing lights, water, and rock — some sort of sinister demonic gateway.

Travel to The Demon Gate, the underground area beneath Dowdun Keep. This is the one location where you'll face a proper fight: make your way through the area to the far end, past two shardbound lesser demons guarding an arena.

On the other side, you'll find the body of the Zamorak mage. The wounds are fresh — singed robes and claw marks raked across his torso. Whatever he was trying to accomplish with his portal magic and emotion-draining schematics, the demons got to him first.
Search the body. There's no sign of Doric's keepsake, but you do find a crumpled schematic of some kind. Take it and return to Doric.

Speak to Doric back in The Nexus. In a moment of sheepish honesty, he admits the mage never actually stole the bronze dog at all — when the wizard knocked into him, the keepsake fell out of his pocket and rolled behind a rock. The whole chase was a wild goose chase.

Feeling guilty, Doric examines the schematic you recovered from the dead mage. He identifies it as a design for some sort of sinister staff and, by way of apology, teaches you how to craft it — the Zamorak staff.
He also mentions that the nodestones seem like they'd be quite useful to have fully operational, and suggests you activate the rest of them around Dowdun Reach for an additional reward.

If you activate all nine nodestones throughout Dowdun Reach and return to Doric, he'll congratulate you — then grumble about adventurers always expecting a reward. He hands over a portal reward pack containing tier 2 Artisan, Construction, Magic, and Mining experience tomes.

rewards: 1x portal reward pack (for activating all nodestones):

name: Contact!
description: Work with Avisk to find a potential shortcut to Fuzan's Volcano

steps.text: Speak to the Avisk crystal in Umbral Sands to start this quest.
Find defunct vault guardians, gather fragments of the crystal helix, and use them together to open a shortcut to Fuzan.
Speak to Vault Guardian Prime in a nearby cave, hints there are 3 crystal helix remains you have to gather.

While still in the room with Vault Guardian Prime, Turn directly opposite of Vault Guardian Prime, follow the red lights through the tunnels, once you reach the big cave, the guardian remains will be on the left-hand side.
This guardian is in the kalphite eggs outside and to the right of the cave entrance.
You will get a message saying that this Helix is missing and to locate the owner of the Footprints.
Speak to Zanik east of the kalphites at an oasis camp and she will give you the crystal helix in exchange for your help.
Last guardian location is within a ruined building, you need a shovel to dig up the guardian. If you have 4 vault shards in your inventory, you can reactivate it and get the Helix.
Return to vault guardian Prime and hand over the crystal helix fragments. Use the crystal helix to pass through the magical barrier.
Speak to Zanik, break the Avisk crystals with a pickaxe, interact with each Vein of Consciousness, and then speak to Zanik once more.

rewards: Icthlarian fetish - a vestige for creating the pharaoh's sceptre.

name: Brink of Extinction
description: Help Zi to become a real KotHaar
location: Speak to the Kot-Haar Zi in The Burning Spire

steps.text: Speak to Zi in Umbral Sands to start this quest. KotHaar-Zi is located in The Burning Spire, directly south-east of Sinking Pyramid on an 'L-shaped' island.
KotHaar-Zi will inform you that their body was not made to survive Scorch and asks for assistance with adapting. They ask you to bring them 3 raw beltfish and 1 cactus steak.

After returning to KotHaar-Zi, they will tell you about four pedestals, scattered around the Burning Spire area - giant black blocks with fire on top. They ask you to touch all four of them in any order and then return to KotHarr-Zi. A blue circle will be added to your map, showing the area the four pedestals are located at.
Pillar 1: Located east of the Sunken Pyramid, on top of a large rock structure.
Pillar 2: Located north of the Sunken Pyramid, behind KotHaar-Zi.
Pillar 3: Located west of the Sunken Pyramid.
Pillar 4: Located south of the Sunken Pyramid, south-west from KotHaar-Zi.
After interacting with all four pillars, return to KotHaar-Zi.

After talking to KotHaar-Zi, they will tell you they are heading to the Cave of Screams, which is located west of the Sunken Pyramid. At the entrance to the Cave of Screams, there will be a bouncer who will ask for a password.
Make your way to the Cave of Screams entrance, located in the top-left corner of The Burning Spire, directly right of the tree icon found on the map.

Talk to the KotHaar Bouncer. Pick any of the three dialogue options - it doesn't matter which you choose. After picking the third dialogue option, you will be given a KotHaar numbering for dummies scroll. Inspect the scroll in your quest inventory.
Talk to the Bouncer again and select the option which says "Two triangles separated by a line?".
You will now be able to access the Cave of Screams. The bouncer will warn you that KotHaar-Zi has changed, and that their core must be forged into a new body, a new body which is controlled by Fuzan.

Upon entering the Cave of Screams, you'll immediately be met by two hostile KotHaar-Xil and a hostile Reforged Zi. Defeat all three enemies. After Reforged Zi is defeated, Zi core will appear on the ground - grab it and then exit the cave.
Talk to the Bouncer. They will award you for assisting with Zi and reward you with the plate of pure obsidian, which unlocks recipe for obsidian cape.
